The Michael Dictionary

Every Tibetan term Geshe Michael Roach has rendered into English across the courses scanned so far, with each rendering he gave it and the passage that attests it. Built segment by segment; this is where it stands today.

Provisional — machine-matched, not yet reviewed Every English phrase here is Geshe Michael’s own, quoted verbatim from the corpus. The machine matched them to Tibetan; it never composed one. Nothing on this page is binding dictionary material, and nothing enters hgm_gloss until a human review pass confirms the mapping.
